# `guest`

Callbacks every mod exports. The host calls them on the main thread; a trap or a run over the time budget (5 ms soft, 25 ms hard per call) counts against the mod, and three hard traps within 60 s disable it.

Package `blockheads:api@0.2.0` · Lua table `bh.guest` · [WIT source](https://github.com/Blockheads-Club/mod-sdk/blob/dev/wit/blockheads-api/guest.wit)

Uses: `types.{value}`, `events.{subscription, event, outcome, command-sender}`, `commands.{command-id, command-outcome}`, `scheduler.{task-id}`, `channels.{channel-id, source}`

## Functions

### `on-enable` <Badge type="info" text="function" />

```txt
on-enable: func() -> result<_, string>;
```

Called once when the mod is enabled (on the server: when the world has loaded). Subscribe to events and register commands here. An error disables the mod and is logged.

### `on-disable` <Badge type="info" text="function" />

```txt
on-disable: func();
```

Called once when the mod is disabled (server stop, reload). Flush state here.

### `handle-event` <Badge type="info" text="function" />

```txt
handle-event: func(sub: subscription, ev: event) -> outcome;
```

Called for every event matching one of the mod's subscriptions.

### `run-command` <Badge type="info" text="function" />

```txt
run-command: func(id: command-id, sender: command-sender, label: string, args: list<string>) -> command-outcome;
```

Called when one of the mod's commands is used. `label` is the name or alias that was typed.

### `run-task` <Badge type="info" text="function" />

```txt
run-task: func(id: task-id);
```

Called when a scheduled task is due.

### `call-service` <Badge type="info" text="function" />

```txt
call-service: func(name: string, method: string, args: value) -> result<value, string>;
```

Called when another mod calls a service this mod provides. `args` and the result are canonical CBOR.

### `on-channel-message` <Badge type="info" text="function" />

```txt
on-channel-message: func(channel: channel-id, origin: source, data: list<u8>);
```

Called when a message arrives on a channel this mod opened.
